description: Dashboard enhancement: Richer data display on index page, improved report visualization with professional styling, and report download UX improvements
steps: In dashboard/templates/index.html: Enhance the dashboard with more data panels - add a 'Market Summary' section that shows key indices inline (S&P, NASDAQ, DOW, VIX, Gold, BTC) with mini sparklines using SVG, add a 'Latest News Sentiment' placeholder section, add 'Sector Rotation' heatmap that shows all 11 GICS sectors with color-coded performance
In dashboard/templates/index.html: Ensure all data fetch functions have proper .catch() handlers with user-friendly error messages shown in the UI (not just console.log)
In dashboard/templates/index.html: Add localStorage try-catch wrappers around all localStorage operations for Safari private mode compatibility
In dashboard/templates/index.html: Fix the market-pulse-strip to be populated from market overview data on load, showing key index values inline

In dashboard/templates/report_view.html: Enhance the report rendering - add proper CSS for markdown tables (zebra striping, hover effects), add a 'Score Distribution Chart' using SVG bar chart showing all 18 agent scores, add section navigation sidebar for the report
In dashboard/templates/report_view.html: Fix the version reference from 7.7.0 to 7.8.1 in the HTML download footer
In dashboard/templates/report_view.html: Add PDF-style print stylesheet so Ctrl+P produces a clean printout
In dashboard/templates/stocks.html: Ensure the report tab renders markdown with proper table formatting (the rendered HTML should apply Bloomberg theme table styles)
In dashboard/static/css/bloomberg.css: Add .md-report table styles with proper borders, padding, striping, and responsive overflow-x:auto wrapper
In dashboard/static/css/bloomberg.css: Add print media query that hides sidebar, navigation, and non-essential UI elements
In dashboard/app.py: Add GET /api/market-overview endpoint that returns the market overview data (if it does not already exist - check and wire up)
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m pytest tests/ passes all existing tests
Dashboard imports without error: python3 -c 'from dashboard.app import app'
index.html has proper .catch() on all fetch calls
bloomberg.css has .md-report table styles and @media print rules
findings: All changes completed successfully. /api/market-overview endpoint already existed in app.py. localStorage calls were already wrapped in try-catch. All fetch calls now have proper .catch() with retry buttons. Version updated to 7.8.1. Print stylesheet added. Score chart SVG function added. .md-report table styles added to bloomberg.css.
